text:
arya: Quick sync — we need to lock an MVP for the Optimize toolkit by Friday. Core surfaces: batching heuristics editor, caching recommendations (prefix/KV), quantization profile suggestions, and eval-triggered alerts. Who owns each, and what are non-negotiable launch gates?

marco: I can take batching heuristics + the editor UI. MVP = rule presets + per-route override + simple throughput/latency preview.

tara: I'll own caching recs and the quant profiles. For caching, we should ship: TTL defaults, prefix vs KV guidance, and a small diagnostics page showing cache hit heatmap.

devon: +1. For quantization, we need clear guidance per model family (FP16/INT8/LLM-Q4 variants) and an automated estimator that predicts accuracy delta vs cost. Not full auto-apply in MVP.

arya: Good. For eval-triggered alerts — product-bot, can we wire the eval pipeline to send alerts into this flow? Need types: quality regression, econ delta (cost per 1k tokens), and latency SLO breach.

product-bot: I can emit alerts for evals that cross thresholds. Need: alert rules, severity, and target recipients/channel. Suggest default rule set: 1) quality drop >3% on golden set -> P1, 2) econ worsening >10% -> P2, 3) p95 latency > SLO*1.2 -> P2.

marco: For rollout, propose a two-week pilot with 3 customers on dedicated instances. Acceptance: no end-user visible regressions, batch configs reduce cost per token >= 8% for those customers, and alert false-positive rate <20%.

tara: UX note — builder should let customers preview token savings and estimated latency change before applying heuristics. Minimal mock: slider for batch size + toggle for prefix cache on/off, with estimated impact.

devon: We should add a safety guard: automatic rollback if eval-triggered alerts fire >2 times within 24h after a change. Add a canary window flag in rollout config.

arya: Launch criteria checklist draft (must pass all):
- Pilot with 3 customers completed (2 PLG + 1 enterprise)
- End-to-end alerting wired into ops channels
- Batching editor + presets live in Console
- Caching recommendations + cache heatmap page
- Quantization estimator integrated, with documented accuracy vs cost examples
- Runbooks for common failure modes (quality regressions, cache thrash)

marco: Timeline ask: engineering needs 4 weeks for runtime & editor glue, +2 for customer pilot support.

tara: Product/Docs: I can draft the decision guide + examples in 1 week if we finalize required outputs now.

arya: Tradeoffs we discussed earlier: strong defaults vs too many knobs. For MVP lean defaults with an "advanced" toggle. Also decide per-customer opt-in for quant recommendations.

devon: Implementation detail: batching preview will use sampled request traces to estimate token distribution. We need consent & sampling config.

arya: Risks: incorrect quant recommendations -> user quality regressions; noisy eval alerts -> alert fatigue. Mitigations: conservative thresholds, customer pilot, clear undo paths.

marco: Action items: 1) Marco: batching editor spec + API contract by Tue (1799999999 + 48h), 2) Tara: caching + quant doc + examples by Wed, 3) Devon: alert rollback/runbook draft by Thu, 4) Aria: coordinate pilot list & legal opt-in.

arya: Minor correction — my name is "arya" (not Aria) :D. I'll compile the launch checklist and circulate.

product-bot: Noted: creating a follow-up thread for pilot invites and checklist.

marco: One last thought — consider a small "economics simulation" that estimates cost delta across 30 days for given heuristics. Could be an MVP dashboard tile.

tara: +1 to econ sim. I'll add it to docs as a recommended future enhancement (not blocking).

arya: OK locking this thread as the single source for MVP asks. I'll follow up with a PR for the roadmap doc and attach the checklist.
